system.description: The builder has given up to 5 other locations the same geomancy as the manse—and the manse may vanish from its current location and appear in one of them, while still drawing Essence from its demesne. This process takes one hour, cannot happen more than once a day, and transports everything within the manse's walls. Usually, manses are built to translocate on a set schedule. Buying this power twice enables the manse to shuttle between 25 locations.
